Novel Summary

[Synopsis: Short, Ugly, and Fat - Transformed into - Handsome and Charming Male God] Reborn in high school, Lu Yan activates his charm system. Short and ugly, he begins a comeback. Looking back, he's become an unattainable, charming male god in the eyes of girls, the envy of all his male classmates. [Height Enhancement Fluid] [Facial Features Adjustment] [Body Proportions] [Charming Aura] [Perfect Hands]... Complete the missions to transform your looks and charm. Navigate the world of once-unattainable goddesses. Prince of Art, Piano Master, Athletic Prodigy, Most Alluring Male Singer—these are all nicknames bestowed upon him by his classmates. Reborn, Lu Yan aims to live a different and more splendid life!
